authority: Owner-approved compact profile, 2026-10-16; sole effective geometry/type/spacing authority for Typst and Python. Physical proof NOT TESTED.

substrate.parchment_mode: light flat tone; no scanned stains, grain, vignette, or repeated texture

ornament.family: one original broken-ring and tapered-rule motif

art.ink_style: economical contour, deliberate hatch, readable silhouette, open negative space

layout.float_figures_note: Full-width figures taller than the space left on the page float to the next page top (no half-page void).
